verdict.rationale: The Search API documents returning "extracted content" and "extracted page text" with results, so the product does ship a content-extraction capability. However, nothing confirms this is the full page rather than query-relevant excerpts, and the CLI docs describe returning "query-relevant page snippets". Missing for 10: explicit documentation that full page text (not excerpts) is returned, any markdown output format, controls over extraction length, and independent or hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As a developer, I can retrieve full page text or markdown for results, not just snippets

citations.quote: Perplexity's Search API returns real-time, ranked web results as structured data, with controls for domains, languages, regions, and extracted content.
Search: ranked web results with extracted page text for your own model.
Get ranked results, domain filtering, multi-query search, and content extraction for developers.
